coordination_summary: Four agent sessions worked in this repository on 2026-10-22: arena/9614479d-gold4 (this one), arena/22b5b06c-gold4, arena/93da71b4-gold4 and arena/b4413b13-gold4. The other three had their work merged to main first (PR #1, #2, #3); this session integrated them instead of replacing them — see the preserved-artifacts table in README.md and docs/legacy/. Two of those sessions recorded that their sandbox could not reach retailer pages, which is why their catalogs are empty. That was a tooling limit, not evidence that no ring can be verified: this session could read the retailer pages, so the dataset is populated and every populated value carries the page it came from. Nothing in any other branch was deleted, renamed or force-pushed.

passes.pass: Pass 1 — source capture (benchmark, law, retailer pages)
passes.scope: Official sources only: FTC, eCFR, U.S. Code, World Gold Council, LBMA, and retailer product/policy pages
checked: World Gold Council gold spot: USD 4,024.36/oz, data as of 21 October 2026 — read from the page's own spot panel
LBMA: benchmark description read; no numerical LBMA price captured because the tables are behind an IBA licence
FTC consumer article: karat definition, solid-gold definition, trademark-beside-karat-mark requirement, plated/filled/vermeil definitions
16 CFR Part 23 § 23.3: gold-content misrepresentation and the ban on calling a hollow-centre item 'solid'
15 U.S.C. § 295: 0.003 assay tolerance and 0.007 whole-article tolerance
FTC credit-card article: billing-error dispute rights
20 retailer product pages fetched: Blue Nile (8), Allurez (4 + policy), VRAI (2 + listing + returns), Mejuri (collection + returns), Anjolee (1), Brilliant Earth (1, policy only)
Every price and weight recorded was copied from the fetched page text, not from search snippets
passes.outcome: Six rows carry a published gram weight (Allurez ×4, VRAI ×2). Nineteen rows carry a price read from the seller's page. Brilliant Earth produced policy facts but no readable price/weight, so it has no product row and no price is quoted anywhere.

passes.pass: Pass 2 — dataset assembly + first integrity audit
checked: Karat fineness table = karat ÷ 24, cross-checked against the FTC karat definition
Legal minimum fineness per stamp = fineness − 0.007 (15 U.S.C. § 295)
Derived gold grams, gold value, legal-minimum value and price/gold multiple recomputed independently by the audit script
Phantom-math check: no derived value may exist for a row without a published weight
Blank-value checks: blank price requires PRICE_UNVERIFIED, blank weight requires NO_WEIGHT_PUBLISHED or WEIGHT_UNVERIFIED
Domain allow-list: every source URL must belong to the named retailer or a government/benchmark host
Banned-domain scan: no marketplace, resale, blog or social domain anywhere in the data
Speculation-language scan on all free-text fields

Two real inconsistencies found on Blue Nile's own pages (18k copy on a 14K page; white-gold copy on a yellow-gold page) and one mixed-metal ambiguity (platinum prongs on a 14K ring) — published on the Flagged page instead of being smoothed over
passes.outcome: Two audit bugs were found and fixed (fineness rounding tolerance, derived-value rounding). The audit now re-derives every number and fails on any mismatch.

checked: Builder formats only values produced by compute.py — no arithmetic in the HTML layer
Every table row carries data-row-id and a source link in a td.src cell
Internal links resolve to files that exist; external links are https and on approved domains
No placeholder tokens rendered in any page
No-hallucination block rendered at the top of every page, with a link back to the Flagged page
